column3: Saori Route ・ Contact at the Park
Why on earth are you here, Kyousuke-shi?
That's one awful question.
I came to collect the materials on behalf of Kuroneko who's busy with the manuscript.
Goodness gracious...
Are you going for Kuroneko-shi's route this time?
Don't call it a route!
And don't mix reality with games!
Hahaha! That's just a light jab♪
I won't do any unnecessary retorts today.
Oh, you're being rather strict today.
But it's still fun to see a different side of Kyousuke-shi.
Anyway, here are the materials in question.
O-Oh. Thanks.
Do you acknowledge receiving them?
I did pass them to you, right? Is the job complete?
I guess so.
Well then, that's all for me!
Don't run away!!
Hahahahaha! You're not going to let me escape that easily after all.
Behave accordingly since you understand that. The weather's already this hot, and I don't wanna heat things up any further.
Don't say that; the warmer, the better!!
I reject that notion!
Well, well, Kyousuke-shi, calm down a little, will you?
Whose fault do you think it is?
Mine?
So you know that after all?! Wicked girl!
Hehe, when you react like that, I can play the boke.
Yes, yes... Anyway, spit it out. Reveal what you're hiding.
Eh, oh...? Y-Yeah.
Hmm???
Now. Kyousuke-shi, is that really all you wanted with me?
I thought you were going to question me, so that's why I got ready for it.
Hey, Saori. Why are you dodging my questions?
I haven't been dodging your questions, Kyousuke-shi.
It's just that your reactions are interesting...
I unknowingly started doing it①
You're still trying to dodge.
Now, now, you don't have to get angry!
Here's the materials you wanted... Well then!
Y-Yeah... Thanks.
Why the "eh?"?
Well... Hm...
I'm surprised that you didn't ask anything else.
Huh, will you talk about it?
There's nothing to say about that; don't you have another topic to talk about?
Lying doesn't help you.
No, I'm being serious!
There's really something, isn't there? I know that!
I got all the otaku goods as evidence! So, say it! You'll feel better If you say it out!
Kyo-Kyousuke-shi, you're too close...
Kuh... This persistent questioning; it's like I'm being interrogated!
Really...?
You finally understand. Good grief...
Look, Saori...
NAY! Continue from where we left off!
Erm... From where we left off...
Now, was I saying anything?
...You. Do you really want me to say it?
Hehe! This is the so-called "foreshadowing"!
By asking many detailed questions, at times a new route may open up...?
Oh...! Then everything will work out as desired!
But, aren't you in Kuroneko-shi's route right now?
Policeman, I'm innocent!
Understood! I get it!
Kyousuke-shi...!
Saori, I was wrong.
At times like this, procedures are important.
Procedures... You say?
The procedures in this particular case are...
Let's go eat some Katsudon for now!
Kyousuke-shi...
It is a painful thing to say but, there are regulations against bringing food into an interrogation room.
Really?!
It would be problematic if the suspect began to riot in the middle of the interrogation.
And even if they were to allow food, all of the delivery expenses would be on the suspect...
You can't reproduce a tear-jerking drama scene in reality!
WHAAAAATTT?!
Or wait, aren't you just trying to speed-talk me?
I am innocent!
That...
Objection! Is this an acceptable retort...?
Suddenly dropping out of character is foul play, Kyousuke-shi.
My bad.
Uu... It's embarrassing to bomb my joke like that...
Oh! That was dangerous. I almost fell into Saori's pace!
Going here and there, this person is really good at manipulating the direction of the conversation.
If I don't watch out, the topic might get completely changed without me noticing...
I'll have to concentrate and watch out!
Hey Saori, please listen to me carefully.
Yes yes, what is it?
Last week! What! Happened to you?!
Nothing at all?
Don't say such a blatant lie. Then why did you pass those goods to me?
To make the story short...
Because those goods recognized Kyousuke-shi as their owner...?
No, that's not possible...
For real?
For real.
Really for real?
Really for real, nothing happened!
Kyousuke-shi, there's one thing I'd like to ask but...
Why are you going to such lengths for me?
...Hey, I'm just worried, you know...
Thank you for that, but...
...you're hiding something, right?
Keeping it secret, and trying to handle it by yourself.
I wonder...
Nope, that's it. That's definitely it!
You're a very reliable person, so you aren't the type to simply reveal your own troubles, right?
That's why it would be weird to say it, but...
You're different from usual. I can clearly tell.
...Kyousuke-shi.
I have only one thing to tell you.
What is it?
There's no harem route with Kuroneko-shi and I, you know that?
I'm not aiming for that!
Then, a harem route with Kiririn-shi, Kuroneko-shi and I...
Hold on a moment. Why did you include Kirino?
No special reason.
Just that I was thinking if that would make you happy...
It's a nightmare when one of the target characters is a sister!
I'm just purely worried about you!
...Purely worried about me...?
Yeah, that's it.
But...
I see... there isn't one...
Heck! What are you making me say?!
Heh... Kyousuke-shi's true face... GET!
Y-YOU!!
Stop changing the subject like that! I'm worried about you...
